proposal: Coherent field dynamics of a harmonically coupled stationary classical array.
physical_closure: The completed alternative retains exact Gibbs static coherent scattering, exact damped normal-mode self motion and the exact disconnected elastic field. It assigns normalized connected self relaxation to the collective connected field.
private_formula: F_source=F_infinity+(S-F_infinity)*(Fs-Fs_infinity)/(1-Fs_infinity). S=F(q,0), F_infinity=|<A_q>|^2 and Fs is the exact mean tagged-particle field correlation. All quantities except the collective time dependence are exact.
coherence_of_source: Fs-Fs_infinity is an average of stationary self-field covariance kernels, hence positive semidefinite. S-F_infinity is the actual nonnegative collective variance and1-Fs_infinity>0. Rescaling and adding the exact nonnegative constant gives a valid stationary correlation kernel with correct equal-time bound and plateau. The source does not claim the microscopic array realizes that alternative kernel.
exact_limits: long-time product-of-means plateau with the stated active bath
independent identical trapped scatterers at coupling0, for every delay
calibration_identifiability: At q=2*pi the static phase factors are all+1. Writing d_ij=(L^-1)_ii+(L^-1)_jj-2(L^-1)_ij, S=N^-1 sum_ij exp[-q^2*T*d_ij/(2K)]. Every off-diagonal d_ij is positive, so dS/dK>0 throughout the unknown interval. Those equal-time records alone identify K globally; finite-delay uncoupled records exercise the exact dynamics too.
independent_reference: Oracle uses scalar damped-mode covariances and Gaussian characteristic factors. Reference builds the full10-dimensional phase-space drift/noise, solves its stationary Lyapunov equation, propagates with a full matrix exponential, then performs2-dimensional Gauss-Hermite integration of each pair of actual complex field factors. It contains neither the mode time formula nor the oracle exponential-of-difference-variance expression.
scope_and_limits: 160 reference cases cover parameter/temperature/coupling endpoints, four wavevectors and five delays. This is bounded feasibility, not a full task/noise-domain validation.

The complete272-point q/time screen is preserved, including exact and near equivalences and small signals. The reported ordinary-signal candidates require all nine K/T corner-and-midpoint signals above.2; no near-zero relative normalization is used.

At reciprocal q with delay1.25 or1.5, the strengthened source remains wrong by at least15.18% across the nine checked K/T settings, with minimum full field correlation.2351. This is a prospective regime, not a frozen hidden set.
Full256 noisy fits, continuous/interior parameter checks, stationary-kernel numerical checks, task API and public grading remain future work. Empirical difficulty is unknown.

A later solver identifying distinct-particle dynamics but miscomputing the Gaussian covariance or phase sum must be classified as a numerical/algebraic failure, not automatically as a retained-closure physics error.
